description.en: Central verbal structure of the SIYAYO Academy learning network, connecting verb functions, verbal systems, sentence construction, timelines, practice and the other kinds of words.
description.es: Estructura verbal central de la red de aprendizaje de SIYAYO Academy, conectando las funciones del verbo, los sistemas verbales, la construcción de oraciones, las líneas de tiempo, la práctica y los demás tipos de palabras.
description.pt: Estrutura verbal central da rede de aprendizagem da SIYAYO Academy, conectando as funções do verbo, os sistemas verbais, a construção das orações, as linhas do tempo, a prática e os demais tipos de palavras.

metadata.notes: Central trunk node. Verb functions and broader verbal systems remain separated so that the original pedagogical structure can expand without flattening different concepts into a single hierarchy.
